research_notes: If target escalation eventually reaches very long turns, the planned +3m gap may cause successor wake after a large interval but remains methodologically valid during boundary search.
The user may later prefer lower idle time, which Phase D explicitly addresses after cap validation.
Premature gap reduction could create overlap and complicate duration-failure attribution.
The current ordering therefore trades temporary experimental inefficiency for cleaner evidence.
Once the cap is known, gap optimization can directly target idle-time reduction.
